user.title: Home Assistant Utils
user.description:
Deploy utility packages, blueprints, and register actions for theme typography patching.

After setup, enable packages in configuration.yaml if not already present:

{packages_snippet}

Then restart Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Assistant Utils is already configured.

error.deploy_failed: Some bundled files could not be deployed. Check the logs.

init.title: Re-deploy bundled assets
init.description: Copy any missing package and blueprint files (existing files are not overwritten).

packages_not_enabled.title: Packages are not enabled in configuration.yaml
packages_not_enabled.description:
Add the following under homeassistant: in configuration.yaml, then restart Home Assistant:

homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages

package_file_missing.title: HA Utils package file is missing
package_file_missing.description: Run action ha_utils.deploy_bundled from Developer tools, or use the integration options to re-deploy missing files. Ensure packages are enabled and restart Home Assistant.

restart_required.title: Restart required after deploying package
restart_required.description: The HA Utils package file was copied to packages/ha_utils.yaml. Restart Home Assistant so the package is loaded.
